title: Literary Design of Ephesians 5:7-13
caption: <bp-cite>Ephesians 5:6-13</bp-cite>. Translation and Literary Design by Tim Mackie for BibleProject Classroom: Ephesians (2019).
usx:
<usx version="2.6">
  <para>
    <group indent="1" sidebar-value="A" type="secondary" sidebar-color="blue">
      <group>
        <verse number="5:7" /> Do not be co-sharers with them 
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group indent="2" sidebar-value="B" type="secondary" sidebar-color="tan">
      <group>
        <verse number="5:8a–b" /> You are light  
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group indent="3" sidebar-value="C" type="secondary" sidebar-color="orange">
      <group>
        <verse number="5:8c" /> Walk as children of light 
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group indent="2" sidebar-value="B'" type="secondary" sidebar-color="tan">
      <group>
        <verse number="5:9–10" /> The fruit of light is … 
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group indent="1" sidebar-value="A'" type="secondary" sidebar-color="blue">
      <group>
        <verse number="5:11a" /> Do not be co-participators in the unfruitful works of darkness 
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a" type="secondary">
      <group>
        <verse number="5:11b" /> but rather expose them 
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b" type="secondary">
      <group>
        <verse number="5:12" /> For the <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="black">things done</char> in hiding by them are shameful even to mention 
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group indent="3" sidebar-value="c" type="secondary">
      <group>
        <verse number="5:13" /> but everything that is <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">exposed</char> by the <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="red">light</char> is made <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="black">visible</char>
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group indent="4" sidebar-value="d" type="secondary">
      <group>
        for everything that is made <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="black">visible</char> is <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="red">light</char>
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
